attr.title: Red Bow
attr.desc: Red Bow is a short horror adventure about Roh, a girl who wakes up in a nightmarish world. Explore dark places, help twisted souls find peace, and discover how your choices shape the ending.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/710600/Red_Bow/) and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.
